The '''''Censure''''' was a [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI bulk transport]] that served in the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] fleet until it was captured by the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]].
